answer: Pay claims through a copper toll road: each identity posts one copper bond per epoch to use the settlement lane, and the toll is neither refundable nor transferable. Each claim then sends a ripple check to five beacon-picked strangers, who independently replay one past job and are paid only if the replay matches. Payouts thaw glacier-slow, one tranche per epoch, only while every ripple check still matches. A fleet of n clones pays n bonds, passes n replays and waits n thaws, while one exposed clone freezes its lookalikes' lane, so clone cost grows with n and honest cost stays flat.
